capabilities: Set document status through a draft → in-review → approved → published lifecycle
Assign a document owner by name or email
Stamp review dates and flag docs past their review cadence as stale
View a governance dashboard with status mix, review freshness, and ungoverned docs
Append every governance action to an in-vault audit log
extras: Manual install only until listed in Community Plugins, and the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README claims the local-only guarantee is enforced by static checks.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track document status, ownership, and review freshness, so a vault can't be governed like company documentation.
summary: Document governance plugin that adds a draft-to-published status lifecycle, owner and review tracking, a dashboard, and an in-vault audit log.
